raw.vi: Seeing how much chaos he and his friends can cause, Nice Burny leads them on a rampage to cause greater chaos to whiny summoners. KEKEKEKEKEKE!

id: Pahlawan dari Kekaisaran Agni, kekuatan dan pedang Vargas yang membara menyulut api di hati orang-orang yang percaya mereka bisa melawan para dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8311006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Hero of the Agni Empire, Vargas' strength and blazing sword lit the flame in the people's hearts to believe that they had a chance against the gods.

raw.en: Hero of the Agni Empire, Vargas' strength and blazing sword lit the flame in the people's hearts to believe that they had a chance against the gods.
raw.es: La fuerza y abrasadora espada de Vargas, héroe del Imperio Agni, encendieron la esperanza en los corazones de la gente para creer que podían contra los dioses.
raw.id: Pahlawan dari Kekaisaran Agni, kekuatan dan pedang Vargas yang membara menyulut api di hati orang-orang yang percaya mereka bisa melawan para dewa.
raw.pt: Herói do Império de Agni, Vargas tem força e uma espada flamejante que acenderam a chama no coração das pessoas que passaram a acreditar que tinham uma chance contra os deuses.
raw.th: วีรบุรุษแห่งจักรวรรดิแอ็กนี่ ความแข็งแกร่งและดาบเปลวเพลิงของวาร์กัสได้จุดไฟในหัวใจของผู้คน ให้เชื่อว่าพวกเขามีโอกาสชนะเทพเจ้าได้
raw.vi: Anh hùng của đế chế Agni, với sức mạnh Vargas và thanh kiếm ánh sáng đã thổi bùng lên ngọn lửa trong trái tim mọi người, tin rằng họ đã có cơ hội chống lại các vị thần.

id: Kekuatannya yang luar biasa ditakuti para dewa juga. Walau telah lama pergi dari kekaisaran, dia diingat rakyat sebagai jago pedang legendaris Agni.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8312006_DESCRIPTION
desc: His immense powers were feared even by the gods. Even long after he left the empire, he was remembered by its people as the legendary swordsman of Agni.

raw.en: His immense powers were feared even by the gods. Even long after he left the empire, he was remembered by its people as the legendary swordsman of Agni.
raw.es: Sus inmensos poderes eran temidos incluso por los dioses. Incluso mucho después de dejar el imperio, él fue recordado por su gente como el legendario espadachín de Agni.
raw.id: Kekuatannya yang luar biasa ditakuti para dewa juga. Walau telah lama pergi dari kekaisaran, dia diingat rakyat sebagai jago pedang legendaris Agni.
raw.pt: Seus poderes imensos eram temidos até pelos deuses. Mesmo muito tempo depois de ter saído do império, ele foi lembrado pelo povo como o lendário espadachim de Agni.
raw.th: พลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ของเขาเป็นที่กลัวเกรงแม้แต่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้า แม้เวลาจะผ่านไปนานหลังจากที่เขาจากไปแล้ว เขาก็ยังเป็นที่จดจำในฐานะนักดาบในตำนานของแอ็กนี่โดยผู้คนที่นั่น
raw.vi: Quyền năng khủng khiếp của ông đã khiến ngay cả các vị thần cũng lo sợ. Thậm chí mãi lâu sau khi ông rời khỏi vương quyền, ông vẫn được nhớ đến bởi người dân như là một kiếm sĩ huyền thoại của Agni.

id: Cantik tapi kuat, Selena dikagumi oleh banyak orang atas kemenangannya memimpin orang Savat dari Kerajaan Sama dalam banyak perang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8321006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Beautiful yet strong, Selena was admired by many for leading the Savat people of the Sama Kingdom to countless victorious battles.

raw.en: Beautiful yet strong, Selena was admired by many for leading the Savat people of the Sama Kingdom to countless victorious battles.
raw.es: Fuerte y hermosa, Selena era admirada por muchos de los jefes Savat del reino Sama por innumerables victorias en batalla.
raw.id: Cantik tapi kuat, Selena dikagumi oleh banyak orang atas kemenangannya memimpin orang Savat dari Kerajaan Sama dalam banyak perang.
raw.pt: Linda mas forte, Selena era admirada por muitos por ter liderado o povo Savat do Reino de Sama em inúmeras batalhas vitoriosas.
raw.th: สวยแต่แข็งแกร่ง เซลีน่าเป็นที่ชื่นชอบของผู้คนมากมายจากการนำชาวซาวัทแห่งราชอาณาจักรซามะไปสู่ชัยชนะนับครั้งไม่ถ้วน
raw.vi: Xinh đẹp nhưng mạnh mẽ, Selena rất được ngưỡng mộ bởi đã dẫn dắt nhiều người dân Savat của Vương quốc Sama đến với vô số trận chiến huy hoàng.

id: Menolak panggilan dari kerajaan, Selena menggunakan pedang kesayangannya Lexida dan memotong para dewa untuk menyelamatkan rakyat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8322006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Refusing the call from her kingdom, Selena instead wielded her treasured sword Lexida and cut down god after god to rescue the masses.

raw.en: Refusing the call from her kingdom, Selena instead wielded her treasured sword Lexida and cut down god after god to rescue the masses.
raw.es: Rehusando al llamado de su reino, Selena blandió su atesorada espada Lexida y liquidó a dios tras dios para rescatar a las masas.
raw.id: Menolak panggilan dari kerajaan, Selena menggunakan pedang kesayangannya Lexida dan memotong para dewa untuk menyelamatkan rakyat.
raw.pt: Se recusando a atender o chamado do reino, Selena empunhou sua estimada espada Lexida e cortou deus após deus para resgatar o povo.
raw.th: ปฏิเสธการเรียกตัวจากราชอาณาจักร เซลีน่าใช้ดาบสุดรักของเธอ เล็กสิดา เข้าสังหารเทพเจ้าไปทีละรายเพื่อปวงชนทั้งหมดแทน
raw.vi: Từ chối lời kêu gọi từ vương quốc của mình, thay vào đó Selena đã giương cao thanh bảo kiếm Lexida của mình và hạ gục lần lượt từng vị thần để cứu chúng sinh.

id: Mengambil Tombak Suci Drevas, Lance meninggalkan keluarga raja Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha untuk melatih keahlian dan kekuatannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8331006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Picking up the Sacred Pike Drevas, Lance gave up his roots as a noble of the Principality of Vriksha to pursue greater skill and power.

raw.en: Picking up the Sacred Pike Drevas, Lance gave up his roots as a noble of the Principality of Vriksha to pursue greater skill and power.
raw.es: Tomando la lanza sagrada Drevas, Lance renunció a sus raíces como noble del principado de Vriksha en busca de mayor poder y destreza.
raw.id: Mengambil Tombak Suci Drevas, Lance meninggalkan keluarga raja Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha untuk melatih keahlian dan kekuatannya.
raw.pt: Segurando o Pique Demoníaco, Drevas, Lance renunciou a suas raízes de nobre do Principado de Vrishka para buscar poderes e habilidades.
raw.th: ถูกเลือกโดยหอกศักดิ์สิทธิ์เดรวาส แลนซ์ละทิ้งฐานันดรในฐานะเชื้อสายขุนนางแห่งมณฑลรัฐพฤกษาเพื่อไขว่คว้าทักษะและพลัง
raw.vi: Lựa chọn Pike Drevas Linh Thiêng, Lance đã từ bỏ nguồn cội cao quý của mình nơi Lãnh Địa Vriksha để theo đuổi kỹ năng và sức mạnh tuyệt vời hơn.

id: Lance melawan para dewa, namun dia tidak sendirian. Ia telah membangnkan Tombak Setan Drevas, yang kini memegang kekuatan Pohon Dunia Altro
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8332006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Lance stood up against the gods, but he was not alone. He had his awakened Demon Pike Drevas, which now held the powers of World Tree Altro.

raw.en: Lance stood up against the gods, but he was not alone. He had his awakened Demon Pike Drevas, which now held the powers of World Tree Altro.
raw.es: Lance enfrentó a los dioses, pero no estaba solo. Contaba con su lanza sagrada Drevas, la cual ahora tiene los poderes del sumo árbol Altro.
raw.id: Lance melawan para dewa, namun dia tidak sendirian. Ia telah membangnkan Tombak Setan Drevas, yang kini memegang kekuatan Pohon Dunia Altro
raw.pt: Lance se rebelou contra os deuses, mas não estava sozinho. Ele tinha seu Pique Demoníaco, Drevas, que agora tinha os poderes da Árvore do Mundo Altro.
raw.th: แลนซ์ลุกขึ้นยืนหยัดต่อต้านเหล่าเทพเจ้า แต่เขาไม่ได้อยู่เพียงลำพัง เขายังมี "เดรวาส" หอกปีศาจที่ตื่นขึ้นมาของเขาด้วย ซึ่งบัดนี้มันมีพลังของต้นไม้โลกอัลโทรด้วย
raw.vi: Lance đã đứng lên chống lại các vị thần, nhưng ông không đơn độc. Ông đã đánh thức Ma Thương Drevas của mình, mà giờ đây nắm giữ quyền năng của Mộc Giới Altro.

id: Eze berlatih dan bertempur dengan keras sebagai prajurit dan diberi hadiah Pedang Gunturh Batootha, memberinya kekuatan guntur yang menghancurkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8341006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Eze trained and fought hard as a  warrior and was rewarded with the Thunder Sword Batootha, which gave him the destructive power of thunder.

raw.en: Eze trained and fought hard as a  warrior and was rewarded with the Thunder Sword Batootha, which gave him the destructive power of thunder.
raw.es: Eze entrenó y luchó arduamente como guerrero y fue recompensado con la espada del rayo Batuza, la cual le dio el poder destructor del trueno.
raw.id: Eze berlatih dan bertempur dengan keras sebagai prajurit dan diberi hadiah Pedang Gunturh Batootha, memberinya kekuatan guntur yang menghancurkan.
raw.pt: Eze treinou e lutou duramente como guerreiro e foi recompensado com a Espada-Trovão Batootha, que deu a ele o poder destrutivo do trovão.
raw.th: อีเซ่ฝึกฝนและต่อสู้อย่างหนักในฐานะนักรบและได้รับรางวัลเป็นดาบสายฟ้าบาทูธ่า ซึ่งได้มอบพลังสายฟ้าแห่งการทำลายล้างแก่เขา
raw.vi: Eze đã tập luyện và chiến đấu gian khổ như một chiến binh và được tưởng thưởng bằng Lôi Kiếm Batootha, mang lại cho ông sức mạnh hủy diệt của sấm sét.

id: Eze mencabik para dewa dengan Pedang Guntur Batootha dan gerak cepatnya, menyelamatkan Dewi Emilia dan orang banyak dalam perang besar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8342006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Eze tore down the gods with his Thunder Sword Batootha and his superior speed, rescuing Goddess Emilia and the masses during the great war.

raw.en: Eze tore down the gods with his Thunder Sword Batootha and his superior speed, rescuing Goddess Emilia and the masses during the great war.
raw.es: Eze derribó a los dioses con su espada de rayo Batuza y su gran velocidad, rescatando a la diosa Emilia y a las masas durante la gran guerra.
raw.id: Eze mencabik para dewa dengan Pedang Guntur Batootha dan gerak cepatnya, menyelamatkan Dewi Emilia dan orang banyak dalam perang besar.
raw.pt: Eze destruiu deuses com sua Espada-Trovão Batootha e velocidade superior, resgadando a Deusa Emilia e o povo durante a grande guerra.
raw.th: อีเซ่ฉีกร่างเหล่าเทพเจ้าด้วยดาบสายฟ้าบาทูธ่ากับความเร็วของเขา และได้ช่วยเหลือเทพธิดาเอมิเลียกับปวงชนมากมายในระหว่างสงครามครั้งยิ่งใหญ่
raw.vi: Eze đã hạ gục các vị thần bằng Lôi Kiếm Batootha và tốc độ siêu tuyệt của mình, giải cứu Nữ Thần Emilia và chúng sinh trong đại chiến.

id: Karena bakatnya yang luar biasa, Atro dikenal sebagai "Santo Pedang" karena tekniknya yang brilian dengan Pedang Terang Urias yang legendaris.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8351006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Gifted with extraordinary skills, Atro was known as the "Sword Saint" for his brilliant technique with the legendary Light Sword Urias.

raw.en: Gifted with extraordinary skills, Atro was known as the "Sword Saint" for his brilliant technique with the legendary Light Sword Urias.
raw.es: Dotado con extraordinario talento, Atro era conocido como el "santo de la espada" por su magnífica técnica con la legendaria espada de luz Urias.
raw.id: Karena bakatnya yang luar biasa, Atro dikenal sebagai "Santo Pedang" karena tekniknya yang brilian dengan Pedang Terang Urias yang legendaris.
raw.pt: Abençoado com habilidades extraordinárias, Atro ficou conhecido como “Santo da Espada” por sua técnica brilhante com a lendária Espada da Luz, Urias.
raw.th: มีทักษะพิเศษเป็นพรสวรรค์ติดตัวแต่เกิด อาโทรเป็นที่รู้จักกันในนาม ดาบนักบุญ จากเทคนิคชั้นเลิศพร้อมกับ อูเรียส ดาบแสงในตำนาน
raw.vi: Bẩm sinh với các kỹ năng đặc biệt, Atro được biết đến với tên gọi "Thánh Kiếm" bởi kỹ thuật tuyệt vời của mình cùng với Thanh kiếm Ánh Sáng huyền thoại Urias.

id: Ketika para dewa menghancurkan biara tempatnya tumbuh, dia menghunus pedangnya dan melepaskan kekuatan Urias yang dahsyat, demi melawan para dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8352006_DESCRIPTION
desc: When the gods destroyed the monastery he grew up in, he drew his sword and unleashed the unearthly powers of Urias, going all out against the gods.

raw.en: When the gods destroyed the monastery he grew up in, he drew his sword and unleashed the unearthly powers of Urias, going all out against the gods.
raw.es: Cuando los dioses destruyeron el monasterio en que creció, desenvainó su espada y liberó los sobrenaturales poderes de Urias contra los dioses.
raw.id: Ketika para dewa menghancurkan biara tempatnya tumbuh, dia menghunus pedangnya dan melepaskan kekuatan Urias yang dahsyat, demi melawan para dewa.
raw.pt: Quando os deuses destruíram o monastério em que ele cresceu, ele pegou sua espada e liberou os poderes sobrenaturais de Urias, enfrentando os deuses.
raw.th: เมื่อเทพเจ้าได้ทำลายวัดที่เขาเติบโตขึ้นมา เขาชักดาบและปลดปล่อยพลังเหนือโลกของอูเรียสออกมา จากนั้นก็ออกไป, และระบายความโกรธทั้งหมดลงที่เทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Khi các vị thần phá hủy tu viện nơi ông lớn lên, ông đã rút kiếm và giải phóng sức mạnh kinh hoàng của thanh kiếm Urias, chiến đấu chống lại tất cả các vị thần.

id: Magress adalah ksatria muda berbakat, anak pemimpin pasukan berkuda. Kalah oleh ayahnya, dia mengasah keahliannya sampai jadi yang terkuat di Bariura.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8361006_DESCRIPTION
desc: As a cavalry leader's son, Magress was a talented young knight. Triggered by his defeat to his father, he honed his skills and soon became the strongest in Bariura.

raw.en: As a cavalry leader's son, Magress was a talented young knight. Triggered by his defeat to his father, he honed his skills and soon became the strongest in Bariura.
raw.es: Como hijo de un jefe de caballería, Magress era un joven y talentoso caballero. Impulsado por la derrota a su padre, perfeccionó sus habilidades convirtiéndose en el más fuerte de Bariura.
raw.id: Magress adalah ksatria muda berbakat, anak pemimpin pasukan berkuda. Kalah oleh ayahnya, dia mengasah keahliannya sampai jadi yang terkuat di Bariura.
raw.pt: Como filho de um líder da cavalaria, Magress era um jovem cavaleiro talentoso. Afetado pela derrota para o próprio pai, ele aprimorou suas habilidades e logo se tornou o mais forte de Bariura.
raw.th: ในฐานะบุตรชายของผู้นำกองพัน มาเกรสเป็นอัศวินหนุ่มมากความสามารถ เมื่อพ่ายแพ้ให้แก่บิดา เขาฝึกฝนลับฝีมือและในไม่ช้าก็ได้กลายเป็นผู้ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในบาริอุระ
raw.vi: Là con trai của một thủ lĩnh kỵ binh, Magress là một hiệp sĩ trẻ tài năng. Nung nấu bởi thất bại của mình với người cha, anh đã mài dũa những kỹ năng của mình và nhanh chóng trở thành người mạnh nhất ở Bariura.

id: Menggunakan tombak raksasa, dia dengan mudah menembus zirah yang paling tebal sekalipun. Bahkan para dewa tidak bisa menghalanginya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8362006_DESCRIPTION
desc: Wielding a gigantic lance, he could effortlessly pierce through the thickest of armor. Even the gods couldn't stand in his way.

raw.en: Wielding a gigantic lance, he could effortlessly pierce through the thickest of armor. Even the gods couldn't stand in his way.
raw.es: Empuñando una lanza gigantesca, podía atravesar sin esfuerzo la más gruesa armadura. Ni siquiera los dioses podían interponerse en su camino.
raw.id: Menggunakan tombak raksasa, dia dengan mudah menembus zirah yang paling tebal sekalipun. Bahkan para dewa tidak bisa menghalanginya.
raw.pt: Usando uma lança gigantesca, ele conseguia penetrar as armaduras mais fortes sem dificuldade. Nem mesmo os deuses conseguiam suportar.
raw.th: ด้วยหอกขนาดยักษ์ เขาสามารถแทงทะลุผ่านเกราะที่หนาที่สุดได้อย่างง่ายดาย แม้แต่เทพเจ้าก็ไม่อาจมาขวางทางของเขาได้
raw.vi: Sử dụng cây thương khổng lồ, ông có thể dễ dàng xuyên qua mọi lớp giáp trụ dày nhất. Ngay cả các vị thần cũng phải e dè tránh đường ông.

id: Tidak ada yang lebih berharga untuk diperjuangkan selain keadilan. Dia tidak segan-segan meluncurkan roket ke apa pun yang dia rasa tidak benar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8311000_DESCRIPTION
desc: There is nothing more worth fighting for than justice. She will not hesitate to launch her missiles at anything she deems unrighteous.

raw.en: There is nothing more worth fighting for than justice. She will not hesitate to launch her missiles at anything she deems unrighteous.
raw.es: Nada amerita luchar más que la justicia. Ella no dudará en lanzar sus misiles a todo aquello que considere injusto.
raw.id: Tidak ada yang lebih berharga untuk diperjuangkan selain keadilan. Dia tidak segan-segan meluncurkan roket ke apa pun yang dia rasa tidak benar.
raw.pt: Nada justifica mais a batalha do que a justiça. Ela não vai hesitar em lançar seus mísseis em qualquer coisa que considere injusta.
raw.th: ไม่มีอะไรที่คุ้มค่ามากพอให้ต่อสู้เพื่อมันมากไปกว่าความยุติธรรม เธอไม่ลังเลที่จะยิงมิสไซล์ใส่ทุกอย่างที่เธอเห็นว่าไม่ถูกต้อง
raw.vi: Không có gì xứng đáng để tranh đấu hơn là công lý. Nàng sẽ không ngần ngại phóng tên lửa vào bất cứ thứ gì nàng thấy bất bình.

id: Saat ia marah, penghancuran menunggu. Menghalangi dia? Bersiaplah untuk meledak!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8312000_DESCRIPTION
desc: When she is angered, only destruction awaits. Stand in her way and be prepared to get blown away.

raw.en: When she is angered, only destruction awaits. Stand in her way and be prepared to get blown away.
raw.es: Cuando se enfurece, solo puede esperarse destrucción. Interponte en su camino y prepárate para ser eliminado.
raw.id: Saat ia marah, penghancuran menunggu. Menghalangi dia? Bersiaplah untuk meledak!
raw.pt: Quando ela se enfurece, só a destruição aguarda. Se ficar em seu caminho, prepare-se para ser destruído.
raw.th: ยามที่เธอโกรธ มีเพียงการทำลายล้างเท่านั้นที่กำลังจะเกิดขึ้น หากคิดจะขวางทางเธอก็จงเตรียมพร้อมที่จะถูกระเบิดเป็นจุล
raw.vi: Khi nàng tức giận chỉ còn lại sự hủy diệt. Hãy thử chắn lối nàng và chuẩn bị được thổi bay đi.

id: Percikan beterbangan selagi roket perangnya meledakkan musuh. Gairahnya akan keadilan terbakar lebih kuat dari sebelumnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8313000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Sparks fly as her war rockets blow her enemies away. Her passion for justice burns stronger than ever.

raw.en: Sparks fly as her war rockets blow her enemies away. Her passion for justice burns stronger than ever.
raw.es: Hay una lluvia de chispas cuando sus cohetes golpean a sus enemigos. Su pasión por la justicia arde más fuerte que nunca.
raw.id: Percikan beterbangan selagi roket perangnya meledakkan musuh. Gairahnya akan keadilan terbakar lebih kuat dari sebelumnya.
raw.pt: Faíscas voam quando seus foguetes de guerra explodem os inimigos. A paixão dela pela justiça queima mais intensa do que nunca.
raw.th: สะเก็ดไฟปลิวไปทั่วขณะที่จรวดสังหารของเธอระเบิดศัตรูให้เป็นจุล ความรักเพื่อความยุติธรรมของเธอ แผดเผาโชติช่วงมากขึ้น ยิ่งกว่าที่เคยเป็นมา
raw.vi: Các tia lửa bay vọt lên bởi hỏa tiễn chiến đấu của nàng đang thổi bay kẻ thù. Khát vọng thực thi công lý của nàng cháy bỏng hơn bao giờ hết.

id: Keren dan bermartabat, dia tidak tunduk pada siapa pun, hanya memercayakan nyawanya pada senapan Gatling.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8321000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Cool and dignified, she bows to no one but her trusty Gatling gun which she has entrusted her life to.

raw.en: Cool and dignified, she bows to no one but her trusty Gatling gun which she has entrusted her life to.
raw.es: Fría y solmene, ella no se inclina ante nadie más que su ametralladora a quien confía su vida.
raw.id: Keren dan bermartabat, dia tidak tunduk pada siapa pun, hanya memercayakan nyawanya pada senapan Gatling.
raw.pt: Fria e digna, ela não se curva a ninguém, exceto sua metralhadora confiável, a que confiou a própria vida.
raw.th: เยือกเย็นและสง่างาม เธอไม่ยอมก้มหัวให้กับผู้ใด นอกจากปืนแกตลิ่งคู่ใจที่เธอฝากชีวิตไว้กับมัน
raw.vi: Lạnh lẽo và tôn quý, nàng chẳng hề khom lưng trước kẻ nào ngoài khẩu súng khét tiếng nàng đã giao phó tính mạng mình cho nó.

id: Dikenal sebagai Lady Pistol, ia tidak pernah lengah ataupun menurunkan pistolnya. Saat beradu cepat, tak ada yang bisa mengalahkannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8322000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Known as the Gun Lady, she never lets her guard or her gun down. When it comes to the quick draw, she is second to none.

raw.en: Known as the Gun Lady, she never lets her guard or her gun down. When it comes to the quick draw, she is second to none.
raw.es: Conocida como la Dama Armada, ella nunca baja la guardia ni su arma. Cuando se trata de desenfundar con rapidez, ella es insuperable.
raw.id: Dikenal sebagai Lady Pistol, ia tidak pernah lengah ataupun menurunkan pistolnya. Saat beradu cepat, tak ada yang bisa mengalahkannya.
raw.pt: Conhecida como Dama das Armas, ela nunca abaixa a guarda ou a arma. Quando o assunto é gatilho rápido, ela não perde para ninguém.
raw.th: รู้จักกันในนามมือปืนสาว เธอไม่เคยลดการป้องกันหรือปืนของเธอลง เมื่อเป็นเรื่องของความไวในการชักปืน เธอก็ไม่เป็นที่สองรองใคร
raw.vi: Được gọi là Tiểu Thư Súng, nàng tuyệt đối không để cận vệ hoặc khẩu súng của mình mất mặt. Nói về rút súng nhanh thì chẳng ai qua mặt được nàng.

id: Bukan lagi soal menang atau kalah. Ia mau balas dendam, yang cepat. Tidak ada waktu untuk yang tidak bisa mengikuti.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8323000_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's no longer a matter of winning or losing. She wants revenge and she wants it fast. She has no time for those who can't keep up.

raw.en: It's no longer a matter of winning or losing. She wants revenge and she wants it fast. She has no time for those who can't keep up.
raw.es: Ya no es un asunto de ganar o perder. Ella busca venganza y la quiere cuanto antes. No tiene tiempo para los que resisten poco.
raw.id: Bukan lagi soal menang atau kalah. Ia mau balas dendam, yang cepat. Tidak ada waktu untuk yang tidak bisa mengikuti.
raw.pt: Não é mais questão de ganhar ou perder. Ela quer vingança e quer logo. Ela não tem tempo para quem não consegue acompanhar.
raw.th: มันไม่สำคัญว่าจะแพ้หรือชนะอีกแล้ว เธอต้องการจะล้างแค้นและเธอต้องการมันอย่างรวดเร็ว เธอไม่มีเวลาจะเสียให้กับคนที่ตามเธอไม่ทัน
raw.vi: Đó không còn là vấn đề thắng hay thua. Nàng muốn trả thù nhanh và ngay. Nàng không có thời gian cho những kẻ không thể theo kịp.

id: Gerhana aneh, siluet tak dikenal. Pemegang kunci telah meraih kekuatan yang telah lama hilang, kekuatan hipnotis yang menyebar di seluruh Gaia Besar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_83510001_DESCRIPTION
desc: A strange eclipse, an unfamiliar silhouette. He who holds the key has tapped into a long lost power, a hypnotic force that is spread across Grand Gaia.

raw.en: A strange eclipse, an unfamiliar silhouette. He who holds the key has tapped into a long lost power, a hypnotic force that is spread across Grand Gaia.
raw.es: Un extraño eclipse y una silueta desconocida. Aquel que posee la llave ha accedido a un poder olvidado, una fuerza hipnótica esparcida por Gran Gaia.
raw.id: Gerhana aneh, siluet tak dikenal. Pemegang kunci telah meraih kekuatan yang telah lama hilang, kekuatan hipnotis yang menyebar di seluruh Gaia Besar.
raw.pt: Um eclipse estranho, uma silhueta desconhecida. Aquele que possui a chave encontrou um poder perdido há muito tempo, uma força hipnótica que se espalhou por Grand Gaia.
raw.th: คราสที่แปลกประหลาด เงาสะท้อนที่ไม่เหมือนตัวจริง เขาถือกุญแจที่เต็มไปด้วยพลังโบราณ แรงเหล่านี้ด้สะเทือนไปทั่วทั้งแกรนไกอา
raw.vi: Một nhật thực kỳ lạ, một bóng hình khác lạ. Anh ta, người nắm giữ chìa khóa đã chạm đến quyền lực đã mất từ lâu, một cảm giác mê hoặc đang lan truyền khắp trên Grand Gaia.

id: Terang dan gelap, baik dan jahat... Bisakah tetap seimbang, atau kau akan menyerah pada sihir Keymaster? Kekuatan gerhana bertambah...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_83520001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Dark and light, good and evil... Can you maintain balance, or will you give in to the Keymaster's magic? The force of the eclipse is growing...

raw.en: Dark and light, good and evil... Can you maintain balance, or will you give in to the Keymaster's magic? The force of the eclipse is growing...
raw.es: Luz y oscuridad, bien y mal... ¿podrás mantener el equilibrio, o cederás ante la magia del Guardián de la llave? La fuerza del eclipse está creciendo...
raw.id: Terang dan gelap, baik dan jahat... Bisakah tetap seimbang, atau kau akan menyerah pada sihir Keymaster? Kekuatan gerhana bertambah...
raw.pt: Luz e sombra, bem e mal... você consegue manter o equilíbrio ou não vai resistir à magia do Chaveiro? A força do eclipse está aumentando...
raw.th: แสงสว่างและความมืด ความดีและความชั่ว...เจ้ารักษษสมดุลย์ของมันได้มั้ย หรือจะมอบมันให้กับคีย์มาสเตอร์ พลังของสุริยคราสกำลังเพิ่มขึ้น
raw.vi: Bóng tối và Ánh sáng, Thiện và Ác... liệu ngươi có thể duy trì sự cân bằng, hoặc ngươi sẽ đưa ra phép thuật của Đại Thủ Lĩnh? Lực thiên thực đang ngày càng tăng...

id: Badai menyebar di langit luas Gaia Besar. Di mana ada badai, guntur akan mengikuti.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8341999_DESCRIPTION
desc: A storm has been brewing across the vast skies of Grand Gaia, and where there is a storm, thunder is bound to follow.

raw.en: A storm has been brewing across the vast skies of Grand Gaia, and where there is a storm, thunder is bound to follow.
raw.es: Una tormenta amenaza los vastos cielos de Gran Gaia, y a la tormenta siempre la acompañan los truenos.
raw.id: Badai menyebar di langit luas Gaia Besar. Di mana ada badai, guntur akan mengikuti.
raw.pt: Uma tempestade está se formando pelos vastos céus de Grand Gaia e, onde há tempestade, há raios.
raw.th: พายุบังเกิดขึ้นทั่วผืนฟ้าแห่งแกรนไกอา และที่นั่นมีทั้งพายุและสายฟ้าอยู่ด้วยกัน
raw.vi: Một cơn bão đã hình thành trên bầu trời Grand Gaia rộng lớn, và khi xảy ra bão, sấm sét là điều tất yếu.

id: Kau dengar guntur? Mereka datang untukmu. Bisakah kau sukses di atas kilat, atau kau akan berlutut pada petir kekuatan mereka?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8342999_DESCRIPTION
desc: Do you hear the thunder? It's coming for you. They're coming for you. Can you thrive above the lightning, or will you kneel to their bolts of power?

raw.en: Do you hear the thunder? It's coming for you. They're coming for you. Can you thrive above the lightning, or will you kneel to their bolts of power?
raw.es: ¿Escuchas el trueno? Viene por ti. Vienen por ti. ¿Puedes superar los relámpagos o te inclinarás ante el poder de sus rayos?
raw.id: Kau dengar guntur? Mereka datang untukmu. Bisakah kau sukses di atas kilat, atau kau akan berlutut pada petir kekuatan mereka?
raw.pt: Está ouvindo o trovão? Está vindo atrás de você. Eles estão vindo atrás de você. Você consegue superar os raios ou será que vai se ajoelhar diante dos choques poderosos?
raw.th: คุณได้ยินเสียงสายฟ้ามั้ย? มันมาเพื่อคุณเลยนะ พวกมันมาเพื่อคุณจะเอาชนะมันได้ไหม หรือจะยอมสบยต่อแรงระเบิดของมัน?
raw.vi: Ngươi có nghe thấy tiếng sấm? Nó đến vì ngươi đấy. Chúng đến vì ngươi. Liệu ngươi có thể vượt trên cả sấm sét, hay là ngươi sẽ quỳ xuống trước những tia sét mạnh mẽ đấy?

id: Dia tidak tahu sedikit pun tentang masa lalunya, namun ia tahu satu yang jelas. Harus jadi lebih kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8331000_DESCRIPTION
desc: She doesn't have the slightest clue about her past, but she knows one thing well and clear. She needs to get stronger.

raw.en: She doesn't have the slightest clue about her past, but she knows one thing well and clear. She needs to get stronger.
raw.es: Ella no tiene ni idea de su pasado, pero hay algo que sabe muy bien. Necesita ser más fuerte.
raw.id: Dia tidak tahu sedikit pun tentang masa lalunya, namun ia tahu satu yang jelas. Harus jadi lebih kuat.
raw.pt: Ela não sabe nada sobre o próprio passado, mas sabe bem de uma coisa. Ela precisa se fortalecer.
raw.th: เธอไม่มีเงื่อนงำเกี่ยวกับอดีตของเธอเลย แต่สิ่งหนึ่งที่เธอรู้ดีและชัดแจ้ง เธอต้องการที่จะแข็งแกร่งขึ้น
raw.vi: Nàng không hề có chút manh mối nào về quá khứ của mình, nhưng nàng biết rõ một điều. Nàng cần phải mạnh mẽ hơn.

id: Pegunungan lebih berbahaya daripada penampakannya, namun tak ada yang bisa menghentikannya menajamkan panca indra dan juga cakarnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8332000_DESCRIPTION
desc: The mountains are more dangerous than they look, but nothing will stop her from sharpening her senses as well as her claws.

raw.en: The mountains are more dangerous than they look, but nothing will stop her from sharpening her senses as well as her claws.
raw.es: Las montañas son más peligrosas de lo que aparentan, pero nada la detendrá de agudizar sus sentidos y sus garras.
raw.id: Pegunungan lebih berbahaya daripada penampakannya, namun tak ada yang bisa menghentikannya menajamkan panca indra dan juga cakarnya.
raw.pt: As montanhas são mais perigosas do que parecem, mas nada vai impedir que ela afie os sentidos e as garras.
raw.th: ภูเขานั้นมันมีอันตรายมากกว่าที่เห็น แต่ไม่มีอะไรจะมาหยุดยั้งเธอจากการลับสัมผัสและกรงเล็บของเธอ
raw.vi: Những ngọn núi trông nguy hiểm hơn chúng thấy, nhưng sẽ chẳng có gì ngăn cản nàng mài dũa các giác quan cũng như móng vuốt của mình.

id: "Jangan pernah meremehkan kucing," ia selalu memperingatkan, dan siapa yang menghadangnya baru sadar saat cakarnya telah tertancap.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8333000_DESCRIPTION
desc: "Never underestimate a cat," she always warns, and those who cross her only realize it when they feel her claws dig in.

raw.en: "Never underestimate a cat," she always warns, and those who cross her only realize it when they feel her claws dig in.
raw.es: Siempre advierte: "nunca subestimes a un gato", y quienes la perturban solo lo comprenden cuando sienten sus garras enterrándose.
raw.id: "Jangan pernah meremehkan kucing," ia selalu memperingatkan, dan siapa yang menghadangnya baru sadar saat cakarnya telah tertancap.
raw.pt: “Nunca subestime um gato” é o que ela sempre avisa, e aqueles que cruzarem o seu caminho só entendem isso quando sentem o poder das garras dela.
raw.th: "อย่าได้ประมาทแมว" เธอมักเตือนอยู่เสมอ และพวกที่แส่หาเรื่องเธอก็มักจะเข้าใจมันหลังจากที่โดนเล็บเธอกระซวกเข้าแล้ว
raw.vi: "Đừng bao giờ đánh giá thấp một con mèo", nàng luôn cảnh báo, và những kẻ ngang qua cô chỉ nhận ra điều đấy khi cảm thấy móng vuốt của nàng đã in sâu vào người họ.

id: Dapat bernubuat, satu-satunya jalan untuk tetap maju di saat perang adalah tersenyum dan terus berjuang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8341000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Being able to prophesize, the only way she could keep going despite the dreadful war was to smile and keep fighting.

raw.en: Being able to prophesize, the only way she could keep going despite the dreadful war was to smile and keep fighting.
raw.es: Siendo capaz de profetizar, su única forma de continuar a pesar de la terrible guerra era sonreír y seguir luchando.
raw.id: Dapat bernubuat, satu-satunya jalan untuk tetap maju di saat perang adalah tersenyum dan terus berjuang.
raw.pt: Com o poder de profetizar, a única forma que ela tinha de seguir em frente apesar da guerra horrível era sorrir e continuar lutando.
raw.th: เพราะมีความสามารถในการทำนาย วิธีเดียวที่เธอจะดำเนินชีวิตต่อไปได้แม้จะต้องเผชิญกับสงครามที่น่ากลัว คือการยิ้มและสู้ต่อไป
raw.vi: Với khả năng tiên tri, cách duy nhất nàng có thể tiếp tục đi cho dù chiến tranh khủng khiếp đã mỉm cười và tranh đấu vẫn tiếp tục.

id: Meski kehilangan ingatan, ia tidak kehilangan percik dan kemauan untuk bertarung. Cengiran lebar saat ia semakin kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8342000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Though she lost her memory, she didn't lose her spark and will to fight, her grin only widened as she got stronger.

raw.en: Though she lost her memory, she didn't lose her spark and will to fight, her grin only widened as she got stronger.
raw.es: Aunque perdió la memoria, no perdió su chispa y deseo de luchar, su sonrisa creció al volverse más fuerte.
raw.id: Meski kehilangan ingatan, ia tidak kehilangan percik dan kemauan untuk bertarung. Cengiran lebar saat ia semakin kuat.
raw.pt: Apesar de ter perdido a memória, ela não perdeu o estímulo e a vontade de lutar, com seu sorriso aumentando à medida que fica mais forte.
raw.th: แม้ว่าเธอจะสูญเสียความทรงจำ แต่เธอก็ไม่ได้สูญเสียการจุดประกายและเจตจำนงของเธอในการต่อสู้ รอยยิ้มของเธอเบิกกว้างขึ้นไปพร้อมกับความแข็งแกร่งของเธอ
raw.vi: Mặc dù bị mất trí nhớ, nàng không mất đi nhiệt huyết của mình và sẽ chiến đấu, nụ cười nàng chỉ mở rộng khi nàng trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn.

id: Peramal tahu saat tidak ada cara mengubah takdir. Satu-satunya jalan untuk menang adalah tertawa dan gembira. Bertarung!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8343000_DESCRIPTION
desc: A fortune-teller knows that there's no way to change fate. The only way to win is to laugh and make merry. Fight-oh!

raw.en: A fortune-teller knows that there's no way to change fate. The only way to win is to laugh and make merry. Fight-oh!
raw.es: Una adivinadora sabe que no hay forma de cambiar el destino. La única forma de ganar es reír y celebrar. ¡A luchar!
raw.id: Peramal tahu saat tidak ada cara mengubah takdir. Satu-satunya jalan untuk menang adalah tertawa dan gembira. Bertarung!
raw.pt: Uma vidente sabe que não tem como mudar o destino. A única forma de vencer é rindo e sendo feliz. Lutai!
raw.th: นักทำนายรู้ดีว่าไม่มีทางเปลี่ยนแปลงชะตากรรม หนทางเดียวที่จะชนะก็คือหัวเราะและสร้างความสำราญ สู้ต่อไป!
raw.vi: Nhà tiên tri biết rằng không có cách nào để thay đổi số phận. Cách duy nhất để giành chiến thắng là cười lên và vui vẻ. Chiến nào-oh!

id: Saat yang lain bergulat di tanah, ia melaju ke langit ke mana pun cahaya pergi, dan bertarung untuk mereka yang mencari kebebasan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8351000_DESCRIPTION
desc: While others struggle on the ground, she soars through the sky to wherever the light reaches, and fights for those who seek freedom.

raw.en: While others struggle on the ground, she soars through the sky to wherever the light reaches, and fights for those who seek freedom.
raw.es: Mientras que otros luchan en el suelo, ella se eleva por los cielos a donde sea que alcance la luz y pelea por aquellos que buscan la libertad.
raw.id: Saat yang lain bergulat di tanah, ia melaju ke langit ke mana pun cahaya pergi, dan bertarung untuk mereka yang mencari kebebasan.
raw.pt: Enquanto os outros lutam no chão, ela voa pelos céus a qualquer lugar onde a luz alcança, lutando contra aqueles que buscam a liberdade.
raw.th: ขณะที่คนอื่นๆ ดิ้นรนกันอยู่บนพื้นดิน เธอบินผ่านท้องฟ้าไปยังทุกที่ที่แสงถึงและต่อสู้เพื่อผู้ที่แสวงหาเสรีภาพ
raw.vi: Trong khi những người khác chiến đấu trên mặt đất, nàng xuyên qua bầu trời đến bất cứ nơi nào ánh sáng vươn tới, và chiến đấu cho những ai tìm kiếm tự do.

id: Jika maut tak bisa menghentikannya, tak ada lagi yang bisa. Selama masih ada seberkas sinar, ia dapat melecaknya, meski ke ujung Gaia.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8352000_DESCRIPTION
desc: If death can't stop her, nothing will. As long as there is a ray of light, she'll trace it down, even to Gaia's end.

raw.en: If death can't stop her, nothing will. As long as there is a ray of light, she'll trace it down, even to Gaia's end.
raw.es: Si la muerte no puede detenerla, nada lo hará. Mientras haya un rayo de luz, ella lo seguirá, incluso hasta el fin de Gaia.
raw.id: Jika maut tak bisa menghentikannya, tak ada lagi yang bisa. Selama masih ada seberkas sinar, ia dapat melecaknya, meski ke ujung Gaia.
raw.pt: Se a morte não pode pará-la, nada vai parar. Enquanto tiver um raio de luz, ela vai encontrá-lo, até os confins de Gaia.
raw.th: ถ้าความตายไม่สามารถหยุดเธอก็ไม่มีสิ่งใดทำได้ ตราบใดที่ยังมีรังสีของแสง เธอจะติดตามมันไปจนกว่าจะแผ่นดินไกอาจะสิ้น
raw.vi: Nếu cái chết không thể ngăn được nàng, sẽ chẳng có gì làm nàng lùi bước. Miễn là có một tia sáng, nàng sẽ bắt lấy nó, ngay cả đến tận cùng Gaia.

id: Lebih kuat, lebih tinggi, lebih cepat. Yang bilang langit adalah batasnya pasti belum pernah bertemu Vanila. Lahir di udara, langit adalah titik mula.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8353000_DESCRIPTION
desc: Stronger, higher, faster. Whoever said the sky's the limit obviously never met Vanila. To this airborne warrior, the sky is but the starting line.

raw.en: Stronger, higher, faster. Whoever said the sky's the limit obviously never met Vanila. To this airborne warrior, the sky is but the starting line.
raw.es: Más fuerte, más alta, más rápida. Quien dijo que el cielo es el límite, obviamente no conoció a Vanila. Para esta guerrera aérea, el cielo es solo el punto de partida.
raw.id: Lebih kuat, lebih tinggi, lebih cepat. Yang bilang langit adalah batasnya pasti belum pernah bertemu Vanila. Lahir di udara, langit adalah titik mula.
raw.pt: Mais forte, mais alto, mais rápida. Aqueles que dizem que o céu é o limite obviamente nunca conheceram Vanila. Para esta guerreira aérea, o céu é apenas o ponto de partida.
raw.th: แกร่งขึ้น สูงขึ้น เร็วขึ้น ใครก็ตามที่บอกว่าท้องว่าคือขีดจำกัด เห็นได้ชัดว่าไม่เคยพบกับวานิลา สำหรับนักรบเวหาผู้นี้ ท้องฟ้าก็เป็นเพียงแค่จุดเริ่มต้นเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Mạnh mẽ hơn, cao hơn, nhanh hơn. Bất cứ kẻ nào nói bầu trời có giới hạn rõ ràng là chưa bao giờ gặp Vanila. Đối với chiến binh trên không này, bầu trời mới chỉ là vạch xuất phát.

id: Tiba di menara yang rumornya ditinggali monster kuat. Gelap dan dingin, udara pengap membuat bulu kuduk berdiri.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8301001_DESCRIPTION
desc: You have arrived at the tower where the formidable monster is rumored to be dwelling. It's dark and the cold, still air sends a chill up your spine.

raw.en: You have arrived at the tower where the formidable monster is rumored to be dwelling. It's dark and the cold, still air sends a chill up your spine.
raw.es: Has llegado a la torre donde se dice que habita un monstruo formidable. Es oscura, y el frío y denso aire te da escalofríos.
raw.id: Tiba di menara yang rumornya ditinggali monster kuat. Gelap dan dingin, udara pengap membuat bulu kuduk berdiri.
raw.pt: Você chegou à torre aonde o formidável monstro supostamente vive. É escuro e o ar frio e parado causa um arrepio na sua espinha.
raw.th: คุรมาถึงหอคอยที่ซึ่งลือกันว่ามีมอนสเตอรืที่น่ากลัวอาศัยอยู่ มันทั้งมืดและหนาว และอากาศก็ยังคงทำให้เสียวสันหลังวาบ
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đến ngọn tháp nơi con quái vật ghê gớm được đồn đại là ẩn náu. Trời tối và lạnh, không khí ngưng trệ làm ngươi ớn lạnh sống lưng.

id: Kini bertemu penjaga menara, kau mulai merasa tidak PD dengan misi ini. Apa lagi yang bersembunyi di dalam kegelapan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8302001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Now that you've met the guardian of the tower, you start to feel less confident about this mission. What else lurks in the darkness?

raw.en: Now that you've met the guardian of the tower, you start to feel less confident about this mission. What else lurks in the darkness?
raw.es: Ahora que te has encontrado con el guardián de la torre, comienzas a sentirte menos seguro de esta misión. ¿Qué más merodeará en la oscuridad?
raw.id: Kini bertemu penjaga menara, kau mulai merasa tidak PD dengan misi ini. Apa lagi yang bersembunyi di dalam kegelapan?
raw.pt: Agora que você conheceu o guardião da torre, você se sente menos confiante sobre essa missão. O que mais aguarda na escuridão?
raw.th: บัดนี้คุรได้พบกับผู้คุ้มกันของหอคอยแล้ว คุณเริ่มจะรู้สึกสูญเสียความมั่นใจเกี่ยวกับภารกิจนี้ ยังมีอะไรอีกที่หลบซ่อนอยู่ในความมืดกันนะ?
raw.vi: Bây giờ ngươi đã gặp hộ vệ của tòa tháp, ngươi bắt đầu cảm thấy thiếu tự tin về nhiệm vụ này. Còn những gì khác ẩn nấp trong bóng tối?

id: Selama ini bagus, tidak ada yang tak bisa kautangani. Tapi lolongan mengerikan dari tingkat atas menara tidak bisa diabaikan…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8303001_DESCRIPTION
desc: So far so good, nothing you can't handle as of yet. But the spooky howls coming from the higher levels of the tower are something you can't ignore...

raw.en: So far so good, nothing you can't handle as of yet. But the spooky howls coming from the higher levels of the tower are something you can't ignore...
raw.es: Hasta ahora, todo marcha bien, pero los aullidos espeluznantes que vienen de los niveles superiores de la torre es algo que no puedes ignorar...
raw.id: Selama ini bagus, tidak ada yang tak bisa kautangani. Tapi lolongan mengerikan dari tingkat atas menara tidak bisa diabaikan…
raw.pt: Até então tudo bem, nada que você não possa enfrentar, mas você não consegue ignorar os uivos assustadores vindo dos andares superiores...
raw.th: ที่ผ่านมายังไหวอยู่ ยังไม่มีอะไรที่คุณรับมือไม่ไหว แต่เสียงโหยหวนชวนขนลุกที่ดังมาจากชั้นบนขึ้นไปของหอคอยนี้เป็นอะไรที่คุณจะเมินเฉยไม่ได้...
raw.vi: Đến nay vẫn ổn thỏa, chẳng có gì ngươi không thể xử lý được, nhưng tiếng hú ma quái vọng từ các tầng trên cao của tòa tháp vẫn là một cái gì đó ngươi không thể lờ đi được...

id: Apa itu?! Bayangan gelap lewat di belakangmu. Atau itu hanya imajinasi? Waspadalah, Pemanggil.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8304001_DESCRIPTION
desc: What's that?! A dark shadow just flashed past you. Or was it just your imagination? Stay alert, Summoner.

raw.en: What's that?! A dark shadow just flashed past you. Or was it just your imagination? Stay alert, Summoner.
raw.es: ¡¿Qué es eso?! Una sombra oscura apareció repentinamente detrás de ti. ¿O solo fue tu imaginación? Anda con cuidado, invocador.
raw.id: Apa itu?! Bayangan gelap lewat di belakangmu. Atau itu hanya imajinasi? Waspadalah, Pemanggil.
raw.pt: O que é aquilo?! Uma sombra escura acabou de passar rapidamente atrás de você. Ou foi a imaginação? Fique alerta, Invocador.
raw.th: นั่นอะไรกัน?! เงาดำมืดเพิ่งแว้บผ่านหลังคุณไป หรือบางทีคุณอาจจะคิดไปเอง? ระวังตัวเอาไว้ซัมมอนเนอร์
raw.vi: Chuyện gì thế?! Một bóng đen vừa mới thoáng qua phía sau ngươi. Hay đó chỉ là do ngươi tưởng tượng? Hãy cảnh giác, Người triệu hồi.

id: Sudah berapa lantai? Semakin gelap dan hujan belum berhenti. Mata berkilauan mengawasi dari bayang-bayang…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8305001_DESCRIPTION
desc: How many floors has it been? It's getting darker and the rain isn't stopping. Gleaming eyes are watching you from behind the shadows...

raw.en: How many floors has it been? It's getting darker and the rain isn't stopping. Gleaming eyes are watching you from behind the shadows...
raw.es: ¿Cuántos pisos van? La oscuridad es cada vez más espesa, y la lluvia no se detiene. Unos ojos resplandecientes te miran detrás de las sombras...
raw.id: Sudah berapa lantai? Semakin gelap dan hujan belum berhenti. Mata berkilauan mengawasi dari bayang-bayang…
raw.pt: Quantos andares já foram? Está ficando mais escuro, e a chuva não parou. Olhos brilhantes te observam por detrás das sombras...
raw.th: ผ่านไปกี่ชั้นแล้วนี่? มันมืดลงเรื่อยๆและฝนก็ไม่ยอมหยุดตกสักที ดวงตาวาววับกำลังจับต้องคุณมาจากด้นหลังเงามืด…
raw.vi: Tòa tháp này có bao nhiêu tầng? Trời đang tối dần và mưa vẫn chẳng ngớt. Những con mắt lấp lánh đang theo dõi ngươi sau bóng tối…

id: Waspadai beast dan monster, mereka sudah lama belum makan… jangan lengah, kau bisa mati.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8306001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Watch out for the beasts and monsters, they haven't had a decent meal in ages... Let your guard down and you might not live to see the sun rise again.

raw.en: Watch out for the beasts and monsters, they haven't had a decent meal in ages... Let your guard down and you might not live to see the sun rise again.
raw.es: Ten cuidado de las bestias y los monstruos: hace eras que no comen otra cosa que basura. Si bajas la guardia, es probable que no veas otro amanecer.
raw.id: Waspadai beast dan monster, mereka sudah lama belum makan… jangan lengah, kau bisa mati.
raw.pt: Fique de olho nas bestas e monstros, eles não têm uma refeição decente em eras... baixe a guarda e talvez você não sobreviva para ver o sol nascer de novo.
raw.th: คอยระวังอสูรร้ายกับมอนสเตอร์ให้ดี พวกมันไม่ได้ลิ้มรสอาหารมื้ออร่อยมานานแล้ว… หากคุณเผลอไม่ระวังตัว คุณอาจจะไม่ได้เห็นแสงตะวันส่องอีกต่อไป
raw.vi: Hãy coi chừng các con thú và quái vật, đã nhiều năm rồi chúng chưa có được một bữa ăn thịnh soạn... cứ hạ vũ khi xuống rồi ngươi có thể sẽ không còn sống để nhìn lại ánh mặt trời nữa.

id: Napasmu semakin berat. Kau capek mendaki, atau penjaga menara memaksamu di luar kemampuan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8307001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your breathing seems heavier than before. Are you getting tired from the climb, or is the guardian of the tower pushing you to your limits?

raw.en: Your breathing seems heavier than before. Are you getting tired from the climb, or is the guardian of the tower pushing you to your limits?
raw.es: Te cuesta más respirar. ¿Te estás cansando de tanto subir o el guardián de la torre te está llevando a tu límite?
raw.id: Napasmu semakin berat. Kau capek mendaki, atau penjaga menara memaksamu di luar kemampuan?
raw.pt: Sua respiração parece mais pesada do que antes. Você está ficando cansado pela subida, ou é o guardião da torre te levando ao limite?
raw.th: คุณหายใจแรงมากกว่าเก่า เป็นเพราะคุณเริ่มเหน็ดเหนื่อยจากการปีนขึ้นไป หรือว่าผู้คุ้มกันของหอคอยทำให้คุณถึงขีดจำกัดกันแน่?
raw.vi: Hơi thở ngươi có vẻ nặng nhọc hơn so với trước. Ngươi đang trở nên mệt mỏi bởi vừa leo lên, hay là lũ bảo vệ của tòa tháp này thúc ép ngươi quá giới hạn?

id: Dia mengejarmu terutama di setiap belokan. Kau harus cepat! Aura mengerikan semakin memenuhi udara setiap menitnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8308001_DESCRIPTION
desc: He is hot on your heels, catching you at every turn and landing. You need to hurry! The ominous aura filling the air is getting thicker by the minute.

raw.en: He is hot on your heels, catching you at every turn and landing. You need to hurry! The ominous aura filling the air is getting thicker by the minute.
raw.es: Te pisa los talones y te persigue a través de cada esquina y recoveco. ¡Tienes que apurarte! La abominable aura que inunda el aire es cada vez más espesa.
raw.id: Dia mengejarmu terutama di setiap belokan. Kau harus cepat! Aura mengerikan semakin memenuhi udara setiap menitnya.
raw.pt: Ele está nos seus calcanhares, te alcançando a cada esquina. Você precisa se apressar! A aura sinistra que preenche o ar está ficando mais espessa a cada minuto.
raw.th: เขาตามไล่จี้คุณมาติดๆ ไม่ว่าคุณจะไปอยู่ซอกมุมไหนก็ตาม คุณจะต้องรีบหน่อย!  กลิ่นอายแห่งความชั่วร้ายเริ่มก่อตัวหนาขึ้นในอากาศทุกๆ นาที
raw.vi: Hắn đang bám sát ngươi, theo ngươi ở từng chỗ rẽ và chỗ dừng chân. Chúng ta cần nhanh lên! Tử khí quái gở tràn ngập không khí đang dày đặc từng phút một.

id: Jangan biarkan dia menghalangimu sekarang! Kau sudah sejauh ini, kebenaran untuk diungkapkan hampir tercapai…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8309001_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can't let him get in your way now! You've come so far, the truth waiting to be unraveled is just a reach away...

raw.en: You can't let him get in your way now! You've come so far, the truth waiting to be unraveled is just a reach away...
raw.es: ¡No puedes dejar que se entrometa! Has llegado muy lejos. La verdad a descubrir está un poco más adelante...
raw.id: Jangan biarkan dia menghalangimu sekarang! Kau sudah sejauh ini, kebenaran untuk diungkapkan hampir tercapai…
raw.pt: Você não pode deixar ele ficar no seu caminho agora! Você veio tão longe, a verdade que espera ser revelada está logo adiante...
raw.th: ตอนนี้คุณจะปล่อยให้เข้ามาขวางทางไม่ได้แล้ว! คุณมาไกลมากและความจริงที่รอการเปิดเผยก็อยู่เพียงแค่เอื้อม…
raw.vi: Ngươi không thể để hắn cản đường ngươi lúc này được! Ngươi đã đi quá xa rồi, sự thật đang chờ được làm sáng tỏ chỉ cách một tầm tay…

id: Kau sampai di puncak menara!... Atau belum? Terlalu gelap untuk bisa melihat, tapi kau merasakan kekuatan kuat di dalam kegelapan…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8310001_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the top of the tower! Or...have you? It's too dark to see, but you can clearly sense a strong power beckoning in the darkness...

raw.en: You've reached the top of the tower! Or...have you? It's too dark to see, but you can clearly sense a strong power beckoning in the darkness...
raw.es: ¡Has llegado a la cima de la torre! ¿O no? No se ve casi nada, pero sin dudas puedes sentir un gran poder entre la oscuridad...
raw.id: Kau sampai di puncak menara!... Atau belum? Terlalu gelap untuk bisa melihat, tapi kau merasakan kekuatan kuat di dalam kegelapan…
raw.pt: Você chegou no topo da torre!... Ou não? Está escuro demais para enxergar, mas você pode sentir claramente um forte poder convidando-o às trevas...
raw.th: คุณมาถึงชั้นบนสุดของหอคอยแล้ว!... หรือว่าไม่? มันมืดเกินไปที่จะมองเห็น แต่คุณสามารถสัมผัสได้ถึงพลังที่แข็งแกร่งกำลังเรียกหาคุณจากความมืดอย่างแน่นอน…
raw.vi: Ngươi đã lên đến đỉnh tòa tháp!... Hay ngươi vẫn chưa? Trời quá tối để thấy, nhưng ngươi có thể cảm nhận rõ ràng một sức mạnh khủng khiếp ẩn trong bóng tối…

id: Tunggu… apa yang dijaga oleh ksatria terkutuk itu bukan menaranya? Apa yang ia coba lindungi… apa?!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8311001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Wait... What the cursed knight has been fighting to guard wasn't the tower? What he was trying to protect was... Wh-What's that?!

raw.en: Wait... What the cursed knight has been fighting to guard wasn't the tower? What he was trying to protect was... Wh-What's that?!
raw.es: Un momento... ¿El caballero maldito no peleaba para proteger la torre? Lo que estaba intentando proteger era... ¡¿Qué es eso?!
raw.id: Tunggu… apa yang dijaga oleh ksatria terkutuk itu bukan menaranya? Apa yang ia coba lindungi… apa?!
raw.pt: Espere... aquilo que o cavaleiro amaldiçoado esteve lutando para proteger não estava na torre? O que ele estava tentando proteger era... o que é aquilo?!
raw.th: เดี๋ยวสิ… สิ่งที่อัศวินต้องสาบนั้นกำลังปกป้องอยู่ไม่ใช่หอคอยหรอกรึ? เข้ากำลังปกป้องอะไรอยู่… มันคืออะไรกันแน่?!
raw.vi: Chờ đã… cái mà hiệp sĩ bị lời nguyền đã chiến đấu để bảo vệ không phải là tòa tháp sao? Những gì anh ta đã cố gắng bảo vệ là... đó là gì thế?!

id: Si monster hanya perlu sekali serang dan ksatria yang kaulawan habis-habisan kalah?! Kau yakin kau bisa menghabisi si monster?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8312001_DESCRIPTION
desc: It only took the monster a single strike to take down the knight you fought so hard against?! Are you sure you can take on the monster?

raw.en: It only took the monster a single strike to take down the knight you fought so hard against?! Are you sure you can take on the monster?
raw.es: ¿Al monstruo le bastó un solo golpe para derrotar al caballero que a ti te costó tanto vencer? ¿Crees realmente que podrás vencer al monstruo?
raw.id: Si monster hanya perlu sekali serang dan ksatria yang kaulawan habis-habisan kalah?! Kau yakin kau bisa menghabisi si monster?
raw.pt: O monstro só precisou de um único ataque para acabar com o cavaleiro que te deu tanto trabalho?! Tem certeza de que quer enfrentar o monstro?
raw.th: เพียงมอนสเตอร์นั่นโจมตีแค่ครั้งเดียว ก็สามารถล้มอัศวินที่คุณต้องรับมือด้วยอย่างยากลำบากได้เชียวรึt?! คุณมั่นใจรึเปล่าว่าจะจัดการมอนสเตอร์นี้ได้?
raw.vi: Con quái vật đó chỉ cần một đòn tấn công duy nhất để hạ hiệp sĩ mà ngươi đã chiến đấu đầy khó khăn như vậy sao?! Ngươi có chắc là ngươi hạ được con quái vật đó?

id: Xenon terluka, kau satu-satunya yang dapat menangkap monster. Cepat, sebelum dia lolos dari menara!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8313001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Now that Xenon is injured, you're the only one who can contain the monster. Hurry, before it escapes the tower!

raw.en: Now that Xenon is injured, you're the only one who can contain the monster. Hurry, before it escapes the tower!
raw.es: Ahora que Xenon está herido, tú eres el único que puede contener al monstruo. ¡Rápido, antes de que escape de la torre!
raw.id: Xenon terluka, kau satu-satunya yang dapat menangkap monster. Cepat, sebelum dia lolos dari menara!
raw.pt: Agora que Xenon está ferido, você é o único que pode conter o monstro. Rápido, antes que ele fuja da torre!
raw.th: บัดนี้ ซีน่อน นั้นบาดเจ็บ คุณเป็นเพียงคนเดียวที่จะหยุดยั้งมอนสเตอร์นั่นได้ เร็วเข้า ก่อนที่มันจะหนีออกไปจากหอคอย!
raw.vi: Lúc này Xenon đã bị thương, ngươi là kẻ duy nhất có thể ngăn cản con quái đó. Nhanh lên, trước khi nó thoát khỏi tòa tháp!

id: Oh tidak! Kau kehilangan si monster! Di mana dia? Tidak boleh buang-buang waktu…lacak dia sebelum dia menyerangmu!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8314001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Oh no! You lost sight of the monster! Where is it? There's no time to waste... You need to track it down before it can ambush you!

raw.en: Oh no! You lost sight of the monster! Where is it? There's no time to waste... You need to track it down before it can ambush you!
raw.es: ¡Oh, no! ¡Has perdido de vista al monstruo! ¿Dónde está? No hay tiempo que perder... ¡Tienes que encontrarlo antes de que pueda emboscarte!
raw.id: Oh tidak! Kau kehilangan si monster! Di mana dia? Tidak boleh buang-buang waktu…lacak dia sebelum dia menyerangmu!
raw.pt: Ah não! Você perdeu o monstro de vista! Cadê ele? Não há tempo a perder... você precisa encontrá-lo antes que ele possa te encurralar!
raw.th: โธ่ ไม่นะ! คุณคลาดสายตากับเจ้ามอนสเตอร์นั่นแล้ว! มันอยู่ที่ไหนกัน? เหลือเวลาไม่มากแล้ว… คุณต้องตามรอยมันให้เจอก่อนที่มันจะซุ่มโจมตีคุณได้!
raw.vi: Ôi, không! Ngươi đã mất dấu con quái vật! Nó ở đâu rồi? Không còn thời gian để lãng phí nữa... ngươi cần theo dõi nó trước khi nó có thể phục kích ngươi!

id: Kegelapan sangat merugikanmu, tapi detak jantung monster terdengar dari jauh. Tunggu, apa itu detak jantungmu sendiri?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8315001_DESCRIPTION
desc: The darkness is putting you at a great disadvantage, but you can hear the monster's heartbeat from a distance. Wait, was that your own heartbeat instead?

raw.en: The darkness is putting you at a great disadvantage, but you can hear the monster's heartbeat from a distance. Wait, was that your own heartbeat instead?
raw.es: La oscuridad es una gran desventaja para ti, pero por suerte puedes oír el latido del corazón del monstruo a lo lejos. ¿O acaso era tu corazón?
raw.id: Kegelapan sangat merugikanmu, tapi detak jantung monster terdengar dari jauh. Tunggu, apa itu detak jantungmu sendiri?
raw.pt: A escuridão está colocando você em uma grande desvantagem, mas você pode ouvir o batimento cardíaco do monstro. Ou é o seu próprio batimento?
raw.th: ความมืดนั้นทำให้คุณเสียเปรียบมากมาย แต่คุณสามารถได้ยินเสียงหัวใจของมอนสเตอร์ตัวนั้นเต้นมาจากระยะไกล เดี๋ยวสิ หรือว่ามันเป็นเสียงหัวใจเต้นของคุณเองกันแน่?
raw.vi: Bóng tối sẽ làm ngươi rất bất lợi, nhưng ngươi có thể nghe được nhịp tim con quái vật từ xa. Chờ đã, đó là nhịp tim của riêng ngươi à?

id: Terus memanjat dan perang tiada akhir membuatmu capek, tapi misi belum selesai. Xenon berharap padamu, Pemanggil.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8316001_DESCRIPTION
desc: The continuous climb and seemingly endless battles have taken a toll on you, but your mission is not over. Xenon is pinning his hopes on you, Summoner.

raw.en: The continuous climb and seemingly endless battles have taken a toll on you, but your mission is not over. Xenon is pinning his hopes on you, Summoner.
raw.es: La gran escalada y las batallas infinitas han socavado tus fuerzas, pero tu misión todavía no termina. Xenon depositó sus esperanzas en ti, invocador.
raw.id: Terus memanjat dan perang tiada akhir membuatmu capek, tapi misi belum selesai. Xenon berharap padamu, Pemanggil.
raw.pt: A subida contínua e as batalhas aparentemente incessantes cobraram seu preço, mas sua missão não acabou. Xenon está depositanto suas esperanças em você, Invocador.
raw.th: การที่ต้องไต่ขึ้นไปเรื่อยๆ และ การต่อสู้ที่ดูเหมือนจะไม่มีจุดจบนั้นทำให้คุณอ่อนล้าสาหัส แต่ภารกิจของคุรยังไม่เสร็จสิ้น ซีน่อน ฝากความหวังของเขาไว้กับคุณแล้วนะซัมมอนเนอร์
raw.vi: Leo núi liên tục và những trận đánh dường như bất tận đã làm ngươi kiệt quệ, nhưng nhiệm vụ của ngươi vẫn chưa xong. Xenon đang đặt hy vọng của hắn vào ngươi, Người triệu hồi.

id: Itu yang terbaik sebisamu? Kamu perlu lebih banyak energi dan kekuatan untuk menyelesaikan misi ini! Yang kuat dan maju!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_8317001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Is that the best you can do? You need to muster more energy and power to complete this mission! Pull yourself together and charge forth!

raw.en: Is that the best you can do? You need to muster more energy and power to complete this mission! Pull yourself together and charge forth!
raw.es: ¿Esto es todo lo que puedes dar? ¡Necesitas más energía y poder para completar esta misión! ¡Recobra la compostura y avanza!
raw.id: Itu yang terbaik sebisamu? Kamu perlu lebih banyak energi dan kekuatan untuk menyelesaikan misi ini! Yang kuat dan maju!
raw.pt: Isso é o melhor que pode fazer? Você precisa reunir mais energia e poder para completar essa missão! Recomponha-se e continue avançando!
